text_original: řowê ce řowa yuwe mê yoyç mê xizmetû şê ʕeladînî, her a şê ʕeladîne.
translation_fa: روزی، زنی و مردی به خدمت شیخ علاءالدین، همان شیخ علاءالدین، آمدند.
translation_en: Once, a woman and a man came to the service of Sheikh Aladin, Sheikh Aladin himself.

text_original: wişkesaɫî bo pêse îsey.
translation_fa: این منطقه دچار خشکسالی بود، مثل حالا.
translation_en: [This region] was in drought, like [it is] now.

text_original: heywandar bo.
translation_fa: او دامدار بود.
translation_en: He was a herdsman.

text_original: mênê qeredax.
translation_fa: آن مرد و همسرش به قره‌داغ آمدند.
translation_en: They (the man and his wife) came to Qaradagh.

text_original: eça xizone eşkewtêwe. heywandare heywanekeyş bero memliketê çoɫû.
translation_fa: آنجا خودشان را در غاری جا دادند. دامدار حیواناتش را به منطقه‌ای خشک و خالی برد.
translation_en: There, they crept into a cave. The herdsman took his animals to a deserted region.

text_original: a wextîyekey ça nîşorew ta hamin bo.
translation_fa: بعد در همان‌جا ماندند تا تابستان.
translation_en: Then, they settled there until the summer.

text_original: ginmê dewrû haminî weharî temamîyo.
translation_fa: نزدیک پایان تابستان، یا بهار، بود.
translation_en: It was near the end of summer, [or] spring.

text_original: mê şewê ce şewa jenêweş bo. wêşû kinaçê ezemêç laşo bo.
translation_fa: شبی فرا رسید؛ او همسری داشت و همسرش همراه با دختر نوجوانشان با او بودند.
translation_en: There came a night when -- he had a wife. She and an adolescent daughter [of his] were with him.

text_original: kuřêş ba. kuřekêş germîyanne nimênêş çene.
translation_fa: او پسرانی داشت. پسرانش که در گرمیان بودند همراهش نیامدند.
translation_en: He had sons. His sons did not accompany him [; they stayed in] Garmiyan.

text_original: eça nîşore. şewê waranê waro.
translation_fa: آنجا ماندند. شبی باران می‌بارید.
translation_en: They settled there (i.e. in that region). One night, it was raining.

text_original: be ʕemrû xwa hewrê gino řû we asmanî.
translation_fa: به فرمان خدا، ابری آسمان را پوشاند.
translation_en: By the order of God, a cloud covered the sky.

text_original: tecrebeş bo. ʕemriş dewrû ṣewû wîs saɫane bo wîs saɫê sî saɫê pa dewrne.
translation_fa: او باتجربه بود. سنش حدود صدوبیست سال، یا شاید صدوسی سال، بود.
translation_en: He was experienced. He was around 120 years old, about 120 or 130.

text_original: maço, “jenekê!”
translation_fa: گفت: «زن!»
translation_en: He said, “Wife!”

text_original: maço, “beɫê!”
translation_fa: گفت: «بله!»
translation_en: She said, “Yes!”

text_original: maço, “êşew waro; tekbîrma mekiryo.”
translation_fa: گفت: «امشب باران می‌آید؛ از پسش برنمی‌آییم.»
translation_en: He said, “It's going to rain tonight; we can't handle (it)”

text_original: ewêç maço, “waranû çêşî?”
translation_fa: او گفت: «چه بارانی؟!»
translation_en: She said, “What rain?!”

text_original: maço, “be xwa waro. ana hewrê sîyaw pise çetrê kewt asman.”
translation_fa: گفت: «به خدا باران می‌آید. آنجا یک ابر سیاه مثل چتر آسمان را پوشانده است!»
translation_en: He said, “[I swear] to God, it will rain. There, a black cloud has covered the sky like an umbrella!”

text_original: şewê firê bijyawe.
translation_fa: در طول شب مدتی غلت زدند و این‌سو و آن‌سو شدند.
translation_en: During the night, they tossed and turned [trying to get comfortable].

text_original: ca a wextî çawre bo. çawrekêne fire ginawe kem.
translation_fa: آن زمان چادر بود. مدتی در چادر این‌سو و آن‌سو غلت زدند.
translation_en: Back then, there were tents. They tossed and turned [in bed] in the tent for a while.

text_original: wextê weyowe, lawaw aman çawre peře bîye awî.
translation_fa: وقتی بالاخره بیدار شدند، سیل آمده بود و چادر پر از آب شده بود.
translation_en: When they finally woke up, the flood had come [and] the tent was filled with water.

text_original: heywane awê berde.
translation_fa: سیل حیوانات را با خود برد.
translation_en: The flood took away the animals.

text_original: epare beʕzêş piřnaşre berd wisiş řoxane.
translation_fa: آن پایین، سیل بعضی از حیوانات را برد و به رودخانه انداخت.
translation_en: Down there, [the flood] took some [animals and] cast [them] into the river.

text_original: beʕzêçiş meno milwa xizana meřekê.
translation_fa: بعضی از حیواناتی که زنده مانده بودند رفتند و خودشان را در غار جا دادند.
translation_en: Some of [the animals] which had survived went [and] squeezed themselves into the cave.

text_original: şewê be ʕemrew xway jenêç nîşore duwê zaroɫê wîno, her a şewê.
translation_fa: همان شب، به فرمان خدا، زن دو نوزاد به دنیا آورد.
translation_en: During that very night, by the order of God, the wife gave birth to two babies.

text_original: wizoşare dilû awê.
translation_fa: او نوزادان را در آبی که وارد چادر شده بود به دنیا آورد.
translation_en: She delivered them in the water [which had flooded in the tent].

text_original: ça menawe ta seʕbe řoj bowe berzepey miđrarê.
translation_fa: آن‌ها تا روز بعد همان‌جا، ایستاده، ماندند.
translation_en: They remained there [in the tent] standing up until the next day.

text_original: seʕbê mila wextî miđya penc bizê menênêw.
translation_fa: روز بعد وقتی اطراف را نگاه کردند دیدند پنج بز از سیل جان سالم به در برده‌اند.
translation_en: The next day, when they looked around, they saw that five goats had survived [the flood].

text_original: awî luwεnêrew serû ane hardîşa bîyênêw.
translation_fa: آب تا سطح کیسه‌های آردی که داشتند بالا آمده بود.
translation_en: The water had risen to the level of the flour [sacks] that they had.

text_original: kuçê qenû çayû a wextîyekey, ne nan hen, ne çay hen, ne çîw hen, ħîç.
translation_fa: کمی قند و چای مانده بود؛ اما دیگر نه نانی بود، نه چای و نه چیز دیگری؛ هیچ‌چیز نمانده بود.
translation_en: [There was] some sugar and tea, well then, there was neither bread, nor water, nor anything else, [there was] nothing [left].

text_original: awê berdenû luwan.
translation_fa: آب همه‌چیز را برده بود و رفته بود.
translation_en: The water had taken [everything] away, [and] it was gone.

text_original: ħeywanê miđa wer. girđ wizaş weɫê.
translation_fa: حیوانات را بیرون راندند و همگی را به جلو بردند.
translation_en: They herded the animals out. They drove all [of them] forth.

text_original: a wextîyekey zaroɫê duwê bawşîşane.
translation_fa: در همان هنگام دو نوزاد را در آغوش داشتند.
translation_en: And they held the babies in their arms.

text_original: yejenekê biřê pîyake maço, “melama pey.”
translation_fa: زن یا مرد چند بار گفت: «نمی‌توانیم بچه‌ها را با خودمان ببریم.»
translation_en: The woman (or) the man said several times, “It's not possible for us [to take the babies]. ”

text_original: tate xway îrayeşa.
translation_fa: مرد گفت: «این خواست خداست.»
translation_en: “Man, this is God's will.”

text_original: mekiryoyç î kuřî xinîkno.
translation_fa: نمی‌شد پسرهای نوزاد را غرق کند.
translation_en: He should not drown the [baby] boys.

text_original: bero mizyoş qiřoɫû derê, hînêwe meřû darê.
translation_fa: یکی از پسرهای نوزاد را برداشت و در حفره‌ای، در شکاف/غارِ درختی، گذاشت.
translation_en: He took him (i.e., one of the baby boys), [and] put him in a hole in a valley, a thingummy, in the hollow of a tree.

text_original: îne min înem jinîyen law, fermawiştû şêxîn, şê ʕeladînîwe.
translation_fa: من این روایت را شنیده‌ام؛ این سخن شیخ است، شیخ علاءالدین.
translation_en: I have heard this tale from -- it is the Sheikh's words -- Sheikh Aladin.

text_original: a wextîyekey minyoş qiřoɫû beřû darêwew.
translation_fa: به هر حال، او را در حفرهٔ یک درخت بلوط گذاشت.
translation_en: Anyhow, he put him into the hollow of an oak tree.

text_original: kûç kera milawe pey germîyanî.
translation_fa: خانواده کوچ کردند و به گرمیان رفتند.
translation_en: They (i.e., the family) migrated [and] went to Garmiyan.

text_original: mila ew kuřekey yoyşa bera. aneşa zilterû ʕalter bo ađî bera.
translation_fa: آن‌ها رفتند و یکی از پسرها را با خود بردند؛ همان که بزرگ‌تر و سالم‌تر بود.
translation_en: They went away [and took] that son. They took one of them (i.e., of the boys), the one who was bigger and healthier; they took him.

text_original: ewî minya qiřoɫû darêwe.
translation_fa: پسر دیگر را در حفرهٔ درخت گذاشتند.
translation_en: They left him (i.e., the other one) in the hole in the tree.

text_original: çî mede xwawinû ʕalemîyanî pase îrayeşa bizêw menêne cîyay sayqekewe.
translation_fa: خواست پروردگار جهانیان چنین بود که یک بز از طوفانی که موجب سیل شده بود جان سالم به در برد و همان‌جا ماند.
translation_en: The will of the lord of all worlds was such that a goat was [accidentally] left behind [alive] from the storm [that caused the flood].

text_original: xway pase îrayeşa ađê mila řeđê baw.
translation_fa: خواست خدا چنین بود که آن‌ها رفتند و از آن منطقه گذشتند.
translation_en: God's will was such that they went away, [and] crossed [that region].

text_original: bizê her werew mê.
translation_fa: و بز پیوسته به سوی درخت می‌آمد.
translation_en: and the goat kept going [to the tree]

text_original: pey minyo serû nerekeyû çêrhur zaroɫeke şot wero.
translation_fa: پاهایش را روی تنهٔ درخت بلوط می‌گذاشت و کودک از پایین شیرش را می‌خورد.
translation_en: [and] putting its feet on the trunk of the oak tree, and the baby drank [its] milk from below.

text_original: saɫê ter mênêwe, maço, “bilmê bizanmê tekbîrî êtir řawêjma çêş bo” ađê, wişkesaɫîn.
translation_fa: سال بعد برگشتند. پدر گفت: «برویم ببینیم با این دورهٔ خشکسالی چه چیزی پیش رویمان است.»
translation_en: The following year, they went back. He (the father) said, “We shall go [and] see what is ahead of us with this period of drought.”

text_original: mênê yagekê.
translation_fa: به همان جای سال قبل رفتند.
translation_en: They went to the same place [as last year].

text_original: wextê miđyo kabra qiřoɫû nerekeyne sere ber mêw milo řû zemînîre.
translation_fa: وقتی نگاه کرد، دید کسی سرش را از حفرهٔ درخت بلوط بیرون می‌آورد و دوباره عقب می‌کشد.
translation_en: When he looked [at the tree], he saw someone put his head out of the hollow of the oak tree and pulled it (his head) back again.

text_original: milo wextê miđyo zaroɫeke bîyen peřû qiřoɫekey.
translation_fa: پدر نزدیک‌تر رفت و دید پسر آن‌قدر بزرگ شده که حفرهٔ درخت را پر کرده است.
translation_en: The father went [closer and] noticed that the baby boy [had grown up so much that] he had filled the hollow of the tree.

text_original: a wextîyekey îđîçşa ardenû.
translation_fa: خانواده او را با خود برگرداندند.
translation_en: They (the family) brought him back.

text_original: marowe kêşoş şiş kîlowê.
translation_fa: پدر او را وزن کرد؛ او شش کیلو از پسر دیگر سنگین‌تر بود.
translation_en: The father weighed him, [and] he weighed six kilos [more than the other son].

text_original: hinû dilû qiřoɫû nerekey şiş kîlowê çîđî zîya bo.
translation_fa: کسی که در حفرهٔ درخت بزرگ شده بود شش کیلو بیشتر از آن دیگری وزن داشت.
translation_en: The one raised in the hollow of the tree weighed six kilos more than him (the one they took with them).

text_original: karû xway eçanen.
translation_fa: کار خدا این‌گونه است.
translation_en: God's work is like this.

text_original: î bizêçe powe awêzane bo mê eçê êđ çeknoşû milo la yagekêş.
translation_fa: بز در حالت آویزان می‌ایستاد، کودک از پستانش شیر می‌خورد و بز دوباره به جای خودش برمی‌گشت.
translation_en: The goat would stay in a hanging position, he (the child) would feed from its udder, and it would go back to its place.

text_original: haɫîta?
translation_fa: می‌بینی؟
translation_en: You see?

text_original: wextê kuřekey maro milo řûweşo waçê pêse neçîrî piřa, piřa.
translation_fa: وقتی به پسری که در حفرهٔ درخت بود نزدیک شد، گفته می‌شد که مثل شکار می‌پرید؛ می‌پرید.
translation_en: When he approached the son [in the hollow of the tree], it was said that he jumped like a prey; he jumped.

text_original: heɫbete bero gêroş. kêştebêş şiş kîlowê ađ çewî zîyater bîyebê.
translation_fa: در نهایت پدر او را گرفت. وقتی وزنش کرد، شش کیلو از پسر دیگر سنگین‌تر بود.
translation_en: Indeed, he (the father) took him; he grabbed him. When he weighed him, he weighed six kilos more than him (the other son).

text_original: îne dastanû gewregerîyû a meşeyxane.
translation_fa: این داستان بزرگیِ شیخ‌هاست.
translation_en: This is the story of the greatness of the sheikhs.

text_original: herçêşa kerdebo herçêşa watebo la xwaywe qisêşa meqboɫe bîyêne.
translation_fa: هر کاری می‌کردند و هرچه می‌گفتند، سخنانشان نزد خدا پذیرفته بود.
translation_en: Whatever they did, whatever they said, their remarks were accepted by God.

text_original: welê îse be qurʕan ne şêx menen, ne meɫa menen, ne kesê hen be weş dađiş berî la.
translation_fa: اما امروز، به قرآن قسم، نه شیخ واقعی مانده، نه ملای واقعی، و نه کسی که بتوان با آرامش از او مشورت گرفت.
translation_en: However, nowadays, I swear on the Quran, neither a [true] sheikh nor a [true] mullah remains, nor is there a person with whom one can take counsel in peace.

text_original: haɫîta?
translation_fa: می‌بینی؟
translation_en: You see?
